inspections.ts createTourInspection (L69-118): 1 inspections insert, 1 customers.last_visit_date update (non-blocking warn on failure), loop uploadSinglePhoto + inspection_photos insert per photo with photo_order i+1. photos.ts uploadSinglePhoto (L38-83) uses expo-file-system File.arrayBuffer() on native, fetch/blob on web, upserts to bucket, returns publicUrl. Signature accepts custom bucket via third arg — used correctly with 'inspection_photos'. OK.
